name: Kan – Israeli Public Broadcasting Corporation
description: Israel's public broadcaster (on air since May 2017, replacing the IBA), running Kan 11, Makan 33, Kan Educational, eight radio stations and the Kan Box VOD service; a major commissioner of drama and documentaries.
description_he: השידור הציבורי של ישראל (משדר מאז מאי 2017, במקום רשות השידור), המפעיל את כאן 11, מכאן 33, כאן חינוכית, שמונה תחנות רדיו ושירות ה-VOD כאן Box; מזמין מרכזי של דרמה ותיעודיות.

key_people.name: Boaz Permeder
key_people.note: Appointed Oct 2026 (Kan BOX, site and app, distribution); previously Kan's chief director and creative director for seven years

notes: Jun 2024: Oren Peldi (head of Kan promo and creative since 2016) appointed to a new VP role covering on-air look, creative and promo, overseeing editing/creative teams and all trailers and marketing output (ICE).
